title: A DISTRICT CONTRACT NAMES THE RIGHT PLACE EVERYWHERE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. A contract to search containers in a district wrote its sentence once, for the sector picked when the board rolled it. After a change of sector the board row named the right place, but the cream card at the Mainframe, the CONTRACT DONE line in the raid and the CONTRACT COMPLETE line on the run card still named a place on the other sector, such as THE SUMP on THE COLD MILE. All three now name the place on the sector being played, as the board row and the raid panel already did. Every other contract reads exactly as before.
now: A district contract names the place on the sector you are playing on the Mainframe card, in the raid and on the run card.
